traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under the genus (Palmae I 3a): rattans with bisexual flowers; shoots that flower once branch high in the canopy (Schoute's model), and suckers.

traits.clonal.note: Dransfield et al. (Genera Palmarum, 2nd ed., 2008), under the genus: it grows in clusters of stems.
